# Alldaypa API

> Reverse-engineered internal API. Unofficial — may change without notice.

## Documentation Index
- `SKILL.md` (this file)
- `references/REFERENCE.md` (detailed endpoint docs)
- `references/ENDPOINTS.json` (machine-readable endpoint catalog)
- `scripts/api.ts` (typed client interface)

## Authentication
Bearer Token — Authentication method detected from captured traffic.

### Providing credentials
- Prefer passing auth as request headers or cookies at call time (do not hardcode secrets into the skill).
- If executing via an external proxy/executor, pass per-call credentials (cookies and/or headers) so they are not persisted.

## Dependencies
- Runtime capable of HTTPS requests.
- If using `scripts/api.ts`: TypeScript toolchain (or transpile to JS).

## Endpoints

### Data Read (7)
- `GET /{id}` — Retrieve specific data record by its ID.
- `GET /action/0` — Retrieve action data.
- `GET /lib/1.0/ra-tracker.js.php` — Retrieve the tracker JavaScript file.
- `GET /stats/{statId}` — Retrieve specific statistical data.
- `GET /uk/assets/data/{dataId}/index.json` — Retrieve a specific data file.
- `GET /uk/assets/data/index.json` — Retrieve the main index data file.
- `GET /unified/v1/master/getSubscriptions` — Get subscription details.

### Data Write (8)
- `POST /actionp/0` — Submit action data.
- `POST /api/v1/p` — Submit primary data point.
- `POST /lib/2.0/ra-collect` — Submit raw activity data for collection.
- `POST /p/conversions/c/o` — Submit conversion data.
- `POST /wa/` — Submit web activity data.
- `POST /webeo-runtime/activity-capture/error` — Report an error during activity capture.
- `POST /webeo-runtime/activity-capture/page-view/{page-viewId}` — Submit page view activity data.
- `POST /webeo-runtime/activity-capture/visit/{visitId}` — Submit visit activity data.

### Realtime (1)
- `POST /eu01/events/t` — Send real-time event data.

### Config (2)
- `GET /consentconfig/{consentconfigId}/settings.json` — Fetch consent configuration settings.
- `GET /dynamics/script/config` — Get script configuration.

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Alldaypa's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Alldaypa data without official API access
- Automate actions on www.alldaypa.com (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Alldaypa frontend uses

## Quick Start

```typescript
import { AlldaypaClient } from "./scripts/api.ts";

// Load captured auth from auth.json
const client = await AlldaypaClient.fromAuthFile("auth.json");

// Make requests to internal endpoints
const result = await client.get("/endpoint");
```

## Captured Authentication

The `auth.json` file contains credentials extracted from browser traffic:
- **Auth headers:** 3 (sec-fetch-storage-access, authorization, session-id)
- **Session cookies:** 60

If auth expires, re-run `unbrowse_login` or `unbrowse_capture` to refresh tokens.

## Error Handling

```typescript
try {
  const data = await client.get("/resource");
} catch (err) {
  if (err.message.includes("401")) {
    // Auth expired — need to re-capture
    console.error("Auth expired, re-run unbrowse_login");
  } else {
    console.error("API error:", err.message);
  }
}
```
